description:
When to use: the caller wants the yield from selling covered calls on this portfolio's long holdings.

    Inputs: portfolio_id from list_portfolios. The caller's token is the owner scope. Do not pass a user id or a symbol list. Short holdings are not covered. The route chooses the call it prices and returns that strike.

    What comes back: the route JSON, unchanged. premium is book currency. annualized_yield_pct is the annualized yield of that premium against the book. A long holding with no listed call is named in missing and is not a zero yield. A portfolio the token does not own is the same not-found answer as a missing id.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID from list_portfolios

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_portfolio_covered_call_yield
title: Get portfolio covered-call yield
